  │    Deploy any app to the cloud            │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Usage: velixir <command> [options]

  Commands:
    login                   Authenticate with your API key
    logout                  Clear the stored API key from this machine
    init                    Create or link a Velixir app (writes .velixir.json)
    deploy                  Package source, upload, build + deploy
    status                  Check current deployment status
    apps                    List your apps
    db <sub>                Manage Postgres databases (run `velixir db` for sub-commands)
    cache <sub>             Manage Valkey caches (run `velixir cache` for sub-commands)
    doctor                  Verify prerequisites (credentials, API, project)
    version                 Print the CLI version

  Deploy options:
    --app, -a <id>          Target app ID (overrides .velixir.json)
    --slot, -s <slot>       Target deployment slot (default: production)
    --source-dir, -d <dir>  Directory to package as source (default: current dir)
    --no-tail               Enqueue the deploy and return without waiting for it

  Init options:
    --app, -a <id>          Link to an existing app instead of creating one

  Login options:
    --key, -k <key>         API key (or enter interactively)
    --url, -u <url>         API base URL (default: https://api.velixir.net)

  Environment variables (for CI/CD):
    VELIXIR_API_KEY         API key
    VELIXIR_APP_ID          Default app ID
    VELIXIR_API_URL         API base URL

  Getting started:

    3. velixir init              (creates app + .velixir.json)
    4. velixir deploy            (upload source, build + deploy in one command)

  Or if you already have an app:
    1. velixir login
    2. velixir init --app <id>   (links existing app)
    3. velixir deploy
